name: COSCO SHIPPING Development Co., Ltd.
summary: COSCO SHIPPING Development Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, research, develops, manufactures, and sells containers in the United States, Asia, Hong Kong, Mainland China, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Container Manufacturing Business; Shipping Leasing Business; Container Leasing Business; and Investment Management Business segments. The company offers dry cargo, refrigerated, and special containers, as well as container houses and after-sales services; integrated shipping, logistics, and industry finance services; and vessel chartering and financial leasing services, including container ships, dry bulk carriers, special-purpose vessels, and tankers.
